scope.en: Cross-course candidate contract only. Course-specific scoring policies remain in the frozen course rubric.
scope.zh: 仅为跨课程候选合同；各课程的具体评分政策仍以冻结的课程 rubric 为准。

en: Each non-full declared leaf has one or more concise, source-grounded deduction entries.
The deducted-point sum exactly equals max_score minus awarded score for that leaf.
A calculation deduction starts at the first material error and does not repeat consequential loss.
Full-credit leaves omit deduction_trace; flagged or low-confidence leaves carry a concise attention_note.
Bonus leaves remain independent and follow their course contract.
zh: 每个非满分的已声明计分叶子都必须有一条或多条简洁、基于作答来源的扣分记录。
每个叶子的扣分合计必须严格等于 max_score 减去实得分。
计算题从首个实质错误扣分，不能重复扣除其连带后果。
满分叶子不写 deduction_trace；有 flags 或低置信度的叶子必须写简洁 attention_note。
bonus 叶子独立处理，并遵循所属课程合同。

privacy_policy.en: Deduction traces are private run-output fields. Public records may contain only aggregate, privacy-audited summaries and immutable public hashes.
privacy_policy.zh: 扣分依据属于私有运行输出字段。公开记录只能包含经隐私审计的汇总信息和不可变的公开哈希。

limitations.en: This plan creates no packet, model output, score, metric, comparison, or teacher-replacement claim. Any future evaluation requires a newly frozen development-only packet and explicit authorization.
limitations.zh: 本计划不创建 packet、模型输出、分数、指标、比较或教师替代声明。任何后续评测都必须新建冻结的仅开发集 packet，并获得明确授权。

next_step.en: After review, decide whether to create a v5.3 development packet; do not run models or access held-out material without a separate authorization.
next_step.zh: 审核后再决定是否创建 v5.3 开发集 packet；未获单独授权前不得运行模型或访问留出材料。
